title: octopus mug
text: octopus mug. These are great... ordered the octopus and the spider.  They work best in drinks with coffee with cream, or hot chocolate so you can see the "surprise" until you drink a bit.  The creatures are quite large in the bottom, so they take up drink space - plus they are white ceramic - not colored at all.  The octopus arms kinda stick up higher so you gotta really fill the cup.
